text: For verifying that red light is not visible to the front, zone 1 shall be bounded in width by two vertical planes. Each plane passes through the point of contact of the vertical planes parallel to the median longitudinal plane that delimit the vehicle's overall width. If there are several points of contact, the foremost shall correspond to the forward plane.

Pass if no red light-emitting surface is directly visible.
summary: For verifying that red light is not visible to the front, zone 1 shall be bounded in width by two vertical planes.
